user_problem: Teams need to understand how two documented API versions differ without testing live endpoints.
unique_output: A compatibility brief separating unchanged, added, removed, renamed, and behaviorally uncertain contract elements.
required_input: Two supplied version specifications containing paths, fields, status codes, and explicit behavior notes.
critical_rule: Treat matching names as compatible only when documented types, requiredness, and semantics also match.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is api-error-example-builder; this compares complete version contracts rather than illustrating documented error handling.
acceptance_scenario: Input v1 requires name:string and returns 200; v2 requires display_name:string and returns 201, with no rename note. Output marks both field and status changes, and labels rename intent unknown.
